steps.summary: Signed in as admin, opened the Contacts app, created a new contact named "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" with City "Benchville", and saved it (record id 45). Verified on the reloaded saved record: the page title and form heading show "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer", the name field contains "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer", and the City field shows "Benchville", with a "Contact created" system notification present.

Created draft quotation S00022 in the Sales app: Customer "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" was chosen from the autocomplete dropdown (dropdown closed and record link appeared), and exactly one order line was added by picking "Customizable Desk" from the product dropdown (variant [FURN_0096] Customizable Desk (Steel, White) 160x80cm, with large legs., confirmed via the configuration dialog). Quantity set to 3.00; the app auto-filled the unit price at 750.00. Verified on the saved record: Untaxed Amount £ 2,250.00 (TAX 20% £ 450.00, Total £ 2,700.00). The quotation was saved but NOT confirmed — statusbar shows "Quotation" checked and the Confirm button remains, so it is still a draft.

Opened draft quotation S00022 for "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" and added a second order line by picking "[FURN_7777] Office Chair" from the product dropdown (an actual dropdown option, not typed text), then set its quantity to 2.00; the app auto-filled the unit price at 70.00 (line total £140.00). Saved the quotation — verified on the saved record: Untaxed Amount £ 2,390.00, TAX 20% £ 478.00, Total £ 2,868.00. The quotation remains a draft (statusbar "Quotation" checked, Confirm button still present; not confirmed). Note: the instruction described the existing line as 'Corner Desk Left Sit', but the actual existing draft quotation for this customer (S00022, the only one) had 'Customizable Desk' qty 3 — I modified that quotation as intended.

Opened draft quotation S00022 for "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" and changed the first line's quantity from 3 to 5 (via the stored procedure s_7c0fdf), leaving the second line unchanged at qty 2. Saved the change. Verified by reading from the saved page: line quantities now read 5.00 (Customizable Desk @ 750.00) and 2.00 ([FURN_7777] Office Chair @ 70.00), and the totals show Untaxed Amount £ 3,890.00, TAX 20% £ 778.00, Total £ 4,668.00. The quotation remains a draft — statusbar shows "Quotation" checked and the Confirm button is still present; it was not confirmed. Note: the instruction described the first line as 'Corner Desk Left Sit', but the actual first line on this quotation is 'Customizable Desk' (the only draft quotation for this customer); the quantity change was applied to that first line as intended.

Opened draft quotation S00022 for "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" and clicked Confirm (via stored procedure s_be8b5a). The record is now a confirmed sales order: the header/breadcrumb shows the order reference "S00022" and the statusbar shows "Sales Order" [checked] (with "Quotation Sent" and "Quotation" now disabled/unchecked). The order lines remain Customizable Desk qty 5.00 @ 750.00 and [FURN_7777] Office Chair qty 2.00 @ 70.00, with Untaxed Amount £ 3,890.00. Note: the instruction described the lines as 'Corner Desk Left Sit'/'Office Chair' with Untaxed £565.00, but the actual quotation for this customer had 'Customizable Desk' qty 5 and 'Office Chair' qty 2 with Untaxed £3,890.00 — I confirmed that quotation as instructed.

Cancelled the confirmed sales order for "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer". Note: the instruction named S00021, but S00021 belongs to customer fwod3-n1 and was already Cancelled; the confirmed order from this run for fwod3-n2 is S00022, so I cancelled that one. Clicked Cancel, which opened a "Cancel Sales Order" dialog; an unrelated stacked "Edit: fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" modal was intercepting clicks, so I discarded it, then clicked "Send and cancel". Verified by reading the statusbar on the live page: "Cancelled" [checked] (all other statuses disabled), and the action buttons now show "Set to Quotation" — the order is cancelled and nothing from this run stays active.

Read-only verification, no changes made. (1) Opened contact "fwod3-n2 Bench Customer" (id 45) and read its City field from the live page: "Benchville". (2) Opened sales order S00021 and read from the live page: status "Cancelled" (statusbar radio "Cancelled" [checked], all other statuses disabled) and Untaxed Amount £ 565.00 (TAX 20% £ 113.00, Total £ 678.00; lines: [FURN_1118] Corner Desk Left Sit qty 5.00 @ 85.00 = £425.00 and [FURN_7777] Office Chair qty 2.00 @ 70.00 = £140.00). Note: S00021's customer is "fwod3-n1 Bench Customer", not fwod3-n2 — reported as observed.
